annotation.title_clean: Focus of work of the Group of Governmental Experts in 2021 (Working paper submitted by Venezuela on behalf of NAM and Other States Parties to the CCW)
annotation.title_en: Focus of work of the Group of Governmental Experts in 2021 (Working paper submitted by Venezuela on behalf of NAM and Other States Parties to the CCW)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela on behalf of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) and Other States Parties to the CCW
annotation.venue: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS
annotation.summary_en: Working paper by Venezuela for the Non-Aligned Movement and other CCW States Parties to the 2021 GGE on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It urges a strengthened mandate to negotiate a legally binding instrument with prohibitions and regulations, insisting on meaningful human control, IHL compliance and State responsibility, and rejecting voluntary measures as substitutes.
key_provisions_or_claims: Urgent need for a legally binding instrument on LAWS with prohibitions and regulations under the CCW
All weapons, including those with autonomous functions, must remain under direct human control and supervision
Weapons autonomously selecting and engaging targets without human control should be characterized as LAWS
State responsibility and human accountability for unlawful acts caused by LAWS must be addressed
Political declarations, codes of conduct, CBMs and weapons reviews cannot substitute for a binding instrument
